title: Rate Limit & Resilience Contract

retry_after.description: A Retry-After value is parsed as seconds or an HTTP-date and an untrusted value yields no delay.
retry_after.claim_boundary: Only header parsing is exercised locally; live provider throttling responses are deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

backoff.description: Retry delays grow exponentially from a base delay and are capped at a maximum.
backoff.claim_boundary: Backoff is computed but no real retry loop is scheduled against a provider. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

jitter.description: A bounded jitter fraction decorrelates retries without exceeding the configured ratio.
jitter.claim_boundary: Jitter is a deterministic function of the supplied random input; entropy sources are supplied by the caller. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

circuit_breaker.description: The breaker opens after a failure threshold and only closes through an explicit reset.
circuit_breaker.claim_boundary: Breaker state is in-memory for this local contract; cross-process and persistent state are deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

idempotency.description: Idempotency keys are validated as stable tokens and secret-shaped values are rejected.
idempotency.claim_boundary: Key validation only; server-side idempotency enforcement is deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

concurrency.description: In-flight work is bounded by permits that are released in arrival order.
concurrency.claim_boundary: The limiter bounds local concurrency only; provider-side quota is deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

health.description: Provider health reports an explicit status and never treats unknown as available.
health.claim_boundary: No live provider health probe is performed; observations are supplied locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local rate-limit and resilience contract, not a live provider integration.
No provider endpoint, quota, or throttle response is exercised by this contract.
Live retry scheduling, provider quota, and external resilience evidence remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
